title: Slow-Cooker Chickpea Curry
subtitle: Vegan chickpea curry in coconut and tomato sauce
excerpt: Chickpeas, spinach, and tinned tomatoes simmered all day in a coconut and spice sauce. Completely vegan and naturally gluten-free. Ready when you walk in the door.

recipe.sourceNotes: Chickpea curry in various forms is eaten across South Asia, the Middle East, and the Caribbean. This version is a simplified British-style curry designed for a slow cooker: everything goes in cold, the coconut milk keeps the sauce creamy, and the chickpeas absorb the spices during the long cook. Spinach wilts in at the end and keeps the colour. Serve with rice or flatbreads.

content.text: The spinach goes in 10 minutes before serving: it wilts in the residual heat without turning grey. If cooking on HIGH all day, stir the coconut milk in during the last hour to keep its freshness. Everything else goes in together at the start.

items.preparation: baby spinach, added at the end

content.text: Put the drained chickpeas, tinned tomatoes, coconut milk, onion, garlic, ginger, garam masala, cumin, turmeric, chilli powder, tomato puree, and salt into the slow cooker. Stir to combine. Cook on LOW for 6 to 8 hours or HIGH for 3 to 4 hours.
Ten minutes before serving, stir in the spinach and replace the lid. The spinach will wilt in the residual heat.
Add the lemon juice. Taste and season. Serve over basmati rice, scattered with fresh coriander.
